extracted.name: Roasted grapes
extracted.description: Make the perfect accompaniment for a Christmas cheeseboard with our roasted grapes. They pair beautifully with goat's cheese especially
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the grapes in a baking dish. Combine the thyme leaves and honey, then drizzle over the grapes. Bake for 25 mins until the grapes have shrivelled. Leave to cool for 5-10 mins before serving.
